title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-07-12
source: Marty Weinberg's 5" 1/4 track Master Audience Reel>HHb CDR-850>CDR>EAC>CDR>EAC>.WAV>TLH>.FLAC

ai_review.summary: Recording is mis‑tagged and contains mostly New Riders material; the acoustic Dead set is fun but the electric sound is muddy.
ai_review.review: Listeners note that this tape is largely a New Riders performance with very little Grateful Dead, and the labeling appears to be mixed up. The brief acoustic set is enjoyable, yet the electric portion suffers from uneven sound quality that can become irritating. Overall the show offers limited Dead content and technical flaws that detract from its value.

ai_rating.rationale: Two low‑star reviews criticize the mislabeling, lack of Dead material, and sound issues, while one high‑star review only confirms the correct date; combined weighting yields a below‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Comments mention mixed‑up material and electric portion sounding muddy or irritating, though the acoustic set is tolerable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Mostly New Riders content with a brief Dead acoustic segment; overall set feels mismatched and lacks substantial Grateful Dead material.
